defect: nested parity loops and automatic index state can resemble incomplete ECC extraction
rationale: The syndrome is initialized before both loops, corrected is initialized before the guarded correction, and out_idx is automatic and reset before every data extraction. Invalid syndromes are left uncorrected rather than used as an out-of-range index; for a legal syndrome the parity positions are skipped and exactly DataWidth data bits are copied.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced SECDED decoding to syndrome calculation, one-bit correction, and data extraction for an 8-bit data word.

mutation.description: Automatic function-like local state and nested combinational loops intentionally build the syndrome and extract non-parity positions.
